Category: Luxury

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Eligible: All Non-Explosive Smart Weapons

“Last week, several top engineers from Raven Microcyber and Microtech were extracted by an unknown megacorp. In unrelated news, Militech has announced an initiative to create smartlinked bullets capable of burrowing into neural cyberlinks and uploading viruses mid-firefight.”

Iconic Weapon Mod. When the weapon inflicts a random (e.g., not a Leg Aimed Shot) Critical Injury onto a target with a Neuroport, the user selects a single DV6 or DV8 Quickhack to apply to the target, even if they are not a Netrunner. When this instead occurs during an Aimed Shot, the user may instead select a single DV6, DV8, or DV10 Quickhack to apply. The Quickhack’s effect and damage is applied independently of the rolled Critical Injury and its Bonus Damage.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
